title: Austin's Boat Tours-Party Boats

Tours visit Devil’s Cove Party Cove and other popular Lake Travis destinations
Everyone must sign a waiver; no ID check
Life jackets must be Coast Guard-approved and properly fitting
Children under 13 must wear life jackets while vessel is underway unless below deck or in enclosed cabin
Three-story lakefront mansion accommodates up to 24 guests for events
Transportation fleet includes 7 vehicles (buses, vans, limousines)
includes: Lily pad included with each rental
Adult life jackets provided on boats
gap: Age minimum for passengers not stated
blurb: Guests can rent double-decker party boats on Lake Travis for private charters or join public lake cruises. Boats come equipped with coolers, lily pads, and optional servers. Transportation, catering, and lodging packages are available for a complete experience.

20% captain’s fee added to all reservations; no additional tipping required but optional
All alcohol is BYOB; no underage drinking allowed

quotes.author: Dustin Bates
quotes.text: Austin Boat tours is fantastic! The staff was extremely kind and accommodating, reaching out in advance about inclement weather. They are very upfront on what their policies are and go above and beyond for their customers. I cannot say enough good things about this business!

quotes.author: Elisa Trujillo
quotes.text: Austin Boat Tours, specifically Captain Jimmy, literally saved our lake day! Our original plans fell through due to technical difficulties, but Captain Jimmy came to the rescue. We had a wonderful time, and I would definitely recommend them for a boat day on the lake!

quotes.author: Alex Campbell
quotes.text: Had a great time out on the lake! Great customer service, nice clean boat, and smooth sailing all day on our trip. Our captain jimmy was awesome too!

quotes.author: Chris Berger
quotes.text: Everyone was very friendly. Our boat Capitan was awesome. Knew good spots to anchor and was helpful during our entire tour.

quotes.author: Denise Trejo
quotes.text: super accommodating! really nice service providers specially cristina and our captain. will def book with them again!
